name: Verdict
passive: Increases ATK by. When characters in your party obtain Elemental Shards from Crystallize or trigger Lunar-Crystallize reactions, the equipping character will gain Seal, increasing Elemental Skill DMG by. The Seal lasts for, and the equipped may have up to Seals at once. All of the equipper's Seals will disappear after their Elemental Skill deals DMG. Up to Seal may be obtained every second through the Lunar-Crystallize reaction.
